title: Derivative of a translated Boolean function
statement: For any natural number $n$, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ be a Boolean function and let $y,y'\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Translating the Boolean derivative of $f$ in direction $y+y'$ by $y$ gives the function $x\mapsto f(x+y)+f(x+y')$.
